notes: Karts running a stated three laps is Racing rather than a vehicle sim, because there is both a lap count and a finish, and route-circuit is the shape for a closed loop run a set number of times — so the Circuit Racing preset applies unchanged. Added terrain-relief for the serene mountainous setting the author asked for, which is what puts tiered alongside the genre-wide P6; the track gains and loses real elevation through the hills but nothing overhangs, since the author ruled out jumps, boosts and shortcuts and that also rules out a multi-tier circuit. The run ends where it starts: the lap trigger on the start-finish line is the terminal detection on the third pass, which I assumed rather than asked. The grid is sized for the four karts the author specified, a number this shape cannot otherwise carry.
